name: allow-ports
description: Lower net.ipv4.ip_unprivileged_port_start to 80 so rootless podman can publish Traefik's :80. Needs sudo once.

name: build
description: Build the rails, nvim, claude and playwright images under podman. Pass --pull to re-fetch the base FROM layers. Run from a worktree.

name: ci
description: Run the CI linting and tests.
run: EXEC_FRESH=1 {{config_root}}/.scripts/podman-wt.sh exec bundle exec rake ci:build:commit

name: claude
description: Run Claude AI assistant in the current terminal window. Set CLAUDE_NEW_TERM=1 (or run claude:newterm) to open it in a new terminal tab instead.
run:
args="${usage_args:-}"
  [ "$args" = "''" ] && args=
  set -- $args
  # podman-claude.sh seeds the home, starts rails and playwright, and reads
  # CLAUDE_NO_TOKEN itself -- so unlike the compose version there is no
  # -e flag list to assemble here.
  case "${CLAUDE_NEW_TERM:-}" in
    ""|0|false|no) exec {{config_root}}/.scripts/podman-claude.sh "$@" ;;
  esac
  exec {{config_root}}/.scripts/claude-newterm.sh "$@"

name: claude:newterm
description: Run Claude in a new tab of the current terminal (falls back to the current window).

name: claude:notoken
description: Run Claude without CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN in the container — the session uses this worktree home's own login, and prompts for /login when the home has none. Credentials are left alone, so you can switch back to the token with `mise run claude`.
run:
args="${usage_args:-}"
  [ "$args" = "''" ] && args=
  exec mise run claude $args

name: claude:notoken:newterm
description: claude:notoken in a new tab of the current terminal.
run:
args="${usage_args:-}"
  [ "$args" = "''" ] && args=
  exec mise run claude $args

name: claude:rebuild
description: Rebuild the Claude image with the latest Claude Code version, busting the layer cache so it actually re-fetches.

name: claude:template:apply
description: Copy the template's Claude config set onto this worktree's home (or --all for every home). Never touches credentials, sessions or other state.
run:
args="${usage_args:-}"
  [ "$args" = "''" ] && args=
  set -- $args
  case "${1:-}" in
    ""|-*) set -- "$CURRENT_WORKTREE_NAME" "$@" ;;
  esac
  case "$*" in
    *--all*) set -- --all $(printf '%s\n' "$@" | grep -v -e "^$CURRENT_WORKTREE_NAME$" -e "^--all$" | tr '\n' ' ') ;;
  esac
  exec {{config_root}}/.scripts/sync-claude-template.sh apply "$@"

name: claude:template:promote
description: Promote this worktree's Claude config set (agents, hooks, skills, settings, plugin records) to the template that seeds new worktrees. Merges plugin records unless --replace; pass a worktree name to promote another worktree.
run:
args="${usage_args:-}"
  [ "$args" = "''" ] && args=
  set -- $args
  case "${1:-}" in
    ""|-*) set -- "$CURRENT_WORKTREE_NAME" "$@" ;;
  esac
  exec {{config_root}}/.scripts/sync-claude-template.sh promote "$@"

name: clean
description: Offer wt:rm for worktrees whose PR merged or whose remote branch was deleted (skips uncommitted work, keeps branches), then remove podman containers, networks, volumes and image tags belonging to worktrees that no longer exist. Lists what it found and asks before deleting either. Leaves live worktrees and the shared base images alone.

name: config:init
description: Create the workspace-root mise.local.toml if missing (prompts for the project name, defaulting to the folder name).

name: console
description: Rails console for this worktree. Run from a worktree.

name: db:dump
description: Dump this worktree's development database and RustFS objects into .container-config/db-dumps/. They restore automatically on the next up against an empty db volume. Run from a worktree.

name: db:dump:clear
description: Remove the dump files, so the next up on an empty db volume runs a full db:prepare instead of restoring.

name: destroy
description: Remove all podman resources (containers, networks, volumes, images) for this project, the rendered systemd units, and the project folder.

name: doctor
description: Check the rootless podman prerequisites: version, socket, privileged-port sysctl, linger.

name: down
description: Stop this worktree's containers AND delete its db, rustfs and node_modules volumes. Prompts first, defaulting to No. Shared volumes are kept. Run from a worktree.

name: exec
description: Run a command in this worktree's rails container, or a transient one if the stack is down. Defaults to a shell. Run from a worktree.

name: fw:allow
description: Allow hostnames/IPs in a running container's firewall until its next start, e.g. `mise run fw:allow claude example.com`. To keep it: CLAUDE_FIREWALL_ALLOW, or .container-config/firewall/*.allow.
usage:
arg "<service>" help="claude, nvim, rails, deps, db, redis, rustfs"
arg "<hosts>…" var=#true help="hostnames or IPv4 addresses/CIDRs"

name: fw:show
description: Show the egress firewall of this worktree's running containers (every worktree from the workspace root): profiles, mode, and what was rejected -- or in log mode, what enforce would reject. Flags containers running without it.

name: hooks:backup
description: Copy the base worktree's git hooks (default: all) into .container-config/git-hooks/, then commit. Run after reviewing a hook that up/doctor flag.

name: hooks:restore
description: Install the backed-up git hooks into the base worktree's .git/hooks. A hook that differs from its backup is kept unless FORCE=1.

name: init
description: Clone the Rails app into a default-branch-named folder as the base worktree (ID 0), write ports.registry and render its mise.local.toml. Usage: mise run init <user/repo | git-url>

name: log:trim
description: Truncate any worktree log over 100 MB. log/test.log is appended by every test run and never rotated.

name: logs
description: Follow a service's container output for this worktree (default rails; e.g. `mise run logs db`; deps and rustfs-init show their journal). Run from a worktree.

name: nvim
description: Connect to Neovim in the container, starting its server first if it is not running.
run:
{{config_root}}/.scripts/podman-wt.sh nvim-up || exit 1
  if [ -n "${NVIM_BACKGROUND:-}" ]; then
    nvim --server localhost:{{ env.NVIM_PORT }} --remote-expr "v:lua.BackgroundSet('$NVIM_BACKGROUND')" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  fi
  kitty_attached=
  case "${KITTY_LISTEN_ON:-}" in unix:/*)
    kitty_sock="/kitty-sock/$(basename "${KITTY_LISTEN_ON#unix:}")"
    nvim --server localhost:{{ env.NVIM_PORT }} --remote-expr "[setenv('KITTY_LISTEN_ON', 'unix:$kitty_sock'), setenv('KITTY_WINDOW_ID', '${KITTY_WINDOW_ID:-}'), system(['kitten', '@', 'set-user-vars', 'IS_VIM=true'])]" >/dev/null 2>&1 && kitty_attached=1
    ;;
  esac
  nvim --remote-ui --server localhost:{{ env.NVIM_PORT }}
  if [ -n "$kitty_attached" ]; then
    nvim --server localhost:{{ env.NVIM_PORT }} --remote-expr "system(['kitten', '@', 'set-user-vars', 'IS_VIM=false'])" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  fi

name: proxy:down
description: Stop the podman proxy stack and its network.

name: proxy:logs
description: Follow a proxy container's output (default traefik; e.g. `mise run proxy:logs dozzle`).

name: proxy:pull
description: Pull updated traefik, dozzle and nginx images and recreate the proxy stack with them.

name: proxy:restart
description: Restart the podman proxy stack, recreating its containers.

name: proxy:status
description: Show the proxy stack's unit and container state plus its URLs.

name: proxy:up
description: Start the podman proxy stack (traefik, dozzle, dashboard). Worktree units pull it in automatically, so this is for using the dashboard without a worktree running.

name: pull
description: Refresh the third-party images (postgres, redis, rustfs). The rails/nvim/claude/playwright images are built locally and never pushed, so they are deliberately excluded -- pulling them would fail on localhost/. Run from a worktree.

name: rails
description: Shell into the running Rails container for this worktree.

name: restart
description: Restart one of this worktree's services (default rails), recreating the container; e.g. `mise run restart nvim`. Run from a worktree.

name: status
description: Show this worktree's unit and container state plus its URLs. Run from a worktree.

name: stop
description: Stop this worktree's containers without removing volumes. Run from a worktree.

name: test
description: Run the full local test suite: Rails unit tests then the JavaScript tests. System tests are not included — run 'test:rails_system' for those.

name: test:javascript
description: Run the JavaScript (Vitest) tests once. Pass a file path or any vitest args (-t 'name', --reporter, ...) to run a subset.
usage: arg "[args]" var=#true help="args forwarded to vitest run (e.g. test/javascript/controllers/foo_controller.test.js, -t sums-the-inputs)"

name: test:javascript_watcher
description: Start Vitest in watch mode — the JS TDD loop. Pass a file path or vitest args to narrow what it watches.
usage: arg "[args]" var=#true help="args forwarded to vitest (e.g. test/javascript/controllers/foo_controller.test.js)"

name: test:rails
description: Run the Rails unit tests. Pass any 'rails test' args (files, file:line, -n, --seed, ...) to run a subset.
usage: arg "[args]" var=#true help="args forwarded to bin/rails test (e.g. test/models/foo.rb:42, -n /pattern/, --seed 123)"

name: test:rails_system
description: Run system tests, ensuring playwright is up first. Does not stop it afterwards -- a Claude session in the claude container may be using the same browser server. Run from a worktree.

name: test:rails_watcher
description: Start the Retest runner — reruns the matching Rails test on every file save.
run:
CMD='gem list -i retest > /dev/null 2>&1 || gem install retest && retest --rails'
  EXEC_FRESH=1 EXEC_ENV=DISABLE_COVERAGE=true {{config_root}}/.scripts/podman-wt.sh exec sh -c "$CMD"

name: units:env
description: Write the unit env file the Quadlet templates read. From a worktree, just that one; from the workspace root, every worktree in ports.registry. up, build and claude rerun it themselves when a .nvmrc, .ruby-version, Gemfile.lock or config change makes it stale; run it by hand only to refresh every worktree at once.

name: units:install
description: Render .container-config/quadlet/ into ~/.config/containers/systemd and reload systemd.

name: units:uninstall
description: Remove the rendered Quadlet units and reload systemd.

name: up
description: Start this worktree's stack. Starts rails; systemd pulls in the network, db, redis, rustfs and the proxy. Run from a worktree.

name: verify
description: Check that Traefik actually discovered the proxy containers over the podman socket, and that routing works end to end.

name: verify:spike
description: Prove Traefik-on-podman discovers and routes to a podman container. Throwaway; needs units:install first.

name: wt
description: Create a worktree: mise run wt <branch|PR#|new-branch-name>
usage: arg "<branch>" help="existing branch name, PR number, or new branch name"

name: wt:ls
description: List all worktrees

name: wt:open
description: Open the current worktree URL in a browser. Pass a browser binary name (e.g. firefox) to override xdg-open.
usage: arg "[browser]" help="optional browser binary; defaults to xdg-open"
run:
url="http://${WORKTREE_HOST}"
  browser="${usage_browser:-}"
  if [ -n "$browser" ]; then
    if ! command -v "$browser" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
      echo "Error: '$browser' not found in PATH" >&2
      exit 1
    fi
    exec "$browser" "$url"
  fi
  if ! command -v xdg-open >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "xdg-open not found. Pass a browser binary: mise run wt:open firefox" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
  exec xdg-open "$url"

name: wt:pick
description: Pick a worktree from a filterable list (stack, Claude state, changes; most recently active first) and act on it: Enter opens its Claude tab, other keys nvim, a shell, logs, up/stop, the browser. Needs fzf.

name: wt:rm
description: Remove a worktree

name: wt:share
description: Expose this worktree (app + S3) over the tailnet for phone testing. One worktree at a time.

name: wt:unshare
description: Stop sharing this worktree over the tailnet.
